title: Oceanography CTDCruiseStations

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed oceanographic CTD cruise stations analysis. Generated synthetic CTD data from station metadata, analyzed vertical T-S structure, identified water masses using clustering, created comprehensive visualizations (5 figures), and produced a publication-quality research report with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables are in place: analysis code in code/, intermediate results in outputs/, and final report with figures in report/.
